messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 page fired: CUDA_ALLOC_FAILED on pool-gpu-eu-west-2 at 6161616161. Severity: P1.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-987654 assigned to oncall-sam. Ack required.

sam: acked. I'm on it, pulling logs and checking metrics.

nina: seeing a spike in kvcache evictions and OOMs for model-replica-42 in eu-west-2. Dashboard shows mem usage hitting 98%.

sam: running quick probe on node gpu-node-7: 
```
ssh gpu-node-7
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,index,memory.total,memory.used,utilization.gpu --format=csv
```
output looked like: 
```
2026-03-15 14:02:01, GPU 0, 24576 MiB, 24430 MiB, 99 %
```

sam: also tailing runtime logs: 
```
2026-03-15T14:01:59Z runtime WARNING: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (cuMemAlloc)
2026-03-15T14:02:00Z serving ERROR: allocation failure for kvcache shard 12
```

alex: could be a very long sequence length job or unbounded batch swallowing memory. Any recent deployments?

marta: no deploys in eu-west-2 in last 2 hours. I see a traffic surge from a customer making long-context evals — top route: /v1/chat/generate with seq_len ~ 64k tokens.

sam: immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable fallback routing for this model to cpu-smallback variant 2) drain affected pool to prevent new allocations 3) notify customers if impact is >5% error rate. Executing now.

infra-ops: running drain command on pool 'pool-gpu-eu-west-2-a': 
```
redctl pool drain --pool pool-gpu-eu-west-2-a --grace-period 30s
```

infra-ops: drain issued. New requests should be routed to fallback pools/model variants.

nina: confirm routing rules applied: traffic shows 70% rerouted to 'gpu-fallback-small-eu' and 30% to 'dedicated-cpu-fallback'. Error rate on original pool still high but no new allocations happening.

sam: throttling long-context requests at edge as additional protection: 
```
red-proxy rule add --match "/v1/chat/generate" --condition "seq_len>8192" --action reject --status 429 --reason "long-request-throttle"
```

marta: applied throttle. Client-side metrics show immediate drop in allocation pressure.

sam: checking customer impact: 1 failing route belonged to customer-id: cust_83b, approx 2% of total hosted requests. Their SLA tier is standard. Suggest a short customer message.

alex: agree. Drafting outreach: 
"We're investigating recent errors on GPU-backed inference in eu-west-2 that may have affected long-context requests. We've applied routing fallbacks and throttles; no data loss. We'll follow up with timeline and mitigation steps."

marta: PagerDuty escalation policy will run if incident unacked or unresolved in 15m. I've set an incident note and pinned the drain/mitigation actions.

incident-bot: note added to INC-987654: drain issued, fallback routing enabled, edge throttle applied.

sam: quick healthcheck after actions: memory pressure falling, nvidia-smi now: 
```
2026-03-15 14:07:10, GPU 0, 24576 MiB, 8600 MiB, 42 %
```

nina: error rate on the cluster dropped from 12% -> 1.1% over last 3 minutes. Latency on fallback pools slightly higher but within SLO for standard tier.

marta: preparing status page update draft: short outage blurb + workaround + ETA for full remediation (investigating model-level rate limits & per-request token caps).

alex: next steps for follow-up: 1) add per-request sequence length enforcement upstream 2) add KV cache reservation heuristic to prevent single request from consuming all shards 3) postmortem if root cause is missing throttles on public route.

sam: handing off to nina for deeper post-incident analysis. I'm available if we need to re-open paging. Handoff at 14:12 UTC.

nina: taking over. I'll collect heap dumps, kvcache shard metrics, and correlate with customer request ids. Filing an incident follow-up ticket and tagging eng-runtime and devex.

infra-ops: closing active drain now that pool is stable; leaving fallback routing enabled for 10m while we monitor.

sam: thanks team. Marking incident as mitigated in PagerDuty but keeping ticket open for root cause investigation. :thumbsup:
